note_text:
S: The patient reports an itchy rash on both wrists that appeared two days after switching to a new hand soap. Scratching spreads the itch. No fever and no swelling of the face or hands.
O: Both wrists show a red, dry, scaly patch with scratch marks; the rash respects the glove line; no blistering; the nails and finger spaces are clear.
A: Irritant contact dermatitis from the new soap.
P: Stop the new soap and return to the previous one. Apply a plain moisturizer after every hand washing. Return if the rash blisters, spreads to the face, or keeps the patient awake at night.
rationale: Objective section has exam findings but no vital signs anywhere. O-01 missing, O-02 present. Overall incomplete.
